safePurpose: Explain a quick metric or imperial BMI calculation for an explicitly confirmed adult aged 20 or older.
privacy: Height, weight and applicability answers remain in the current browser page and must not be stored or transmitted.
disallowed: Diagnosing obesity, disease, fitness, nutrition or health
Setting a target weight or weight-loss plan
Applying adult screening bands to children, teenagers or pregnancy
Presenting a rounded value or screening boundary as clinical certainty
staticText: Adult BMI Calculator for /tools/bmi-calculator/. Explain the direct metric or imperial working, converted measurements, unrounded value and limited adult population screening band only after the user confirms the calculation is for an adult aged 20 or older. A boundary-proximity note means small measurement differences could change the displayed band; it is not a risk estimate. Do not diagnose obesity or health, set a target weight or weight-loss plan, apply adult bands to children, teenagers or pregnancy, or provide treatment or false reassurance. Height and weight are sensitive and local: do not request identifiers, store, log, upload, sync, email, add to URLs or send them to analytics. Sources reviewed 2026-07-26: CDC Adult BMI Calculator and WHO Obesity and Overweight fact sheet.
